title: Any ship of ours gives the high-value loot it stores at Central Nexus (ember gland, crystal melt, caustic sac, noble condensate) to the trader named there (strict classes)
note: 2026-11-25 13:14 UTC (Mercury): orders ENT-093 block MERCURY (offer Military and Intel a give route for their stored melt) and P5, rules F23, F24. A named variant (P7) of the give-<role>-stores-* routes: those open only when the giver stores 20 creature carapace or 50 iron ore, so a ship that stores only loot never gives it. This one opens on any of the four goods at 2 units or more (dispatch.stored_missing: an `items` list is met by any one of them), for every role (class deliver), and only for a ship within one jump (max_jumps 1). The goods go to the trader named for this station (data/fleet/receivers.json, handover.py); Trade's sell and carry routes take them where a bid stands: ember gland at Crimson War Citadel (Krynn) bid 6,299 x 18 at 13:00 UTC, caustic sac at Hex Star 1,368 x 28 at 13:07 UTC (table books); crystal melt waits stored for a bid to refill. No open need names any of the four (tool stock, view surplus, 13:09 UTC). Each Admiral puts it in its own plan or leaves it out.
